        out.append(f"{prefix}<your-ssh-private-key>{nl}")

    if 'END OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY' in content:

        out.append(line)
        continue
    if in_key:
        replaced += 1
        continue

    p.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
    print("ssh_config: UPDATED")
else:
    print("ssh_config: no change")
